create_image_dataset: create an image dataset from image files using ClassyHubInterface with a specified phase type
predict_with_hub_interface: predict output labels for input data using the ClassyHubInterface predict method
extract_features_from_model: extract feature vectors from input data using the ClassyHubInterface extract_features method
build_hub_interface_from_task: build a ClassyHubInterface from a ClassyTask using the from_task class method
build_hub_interface_from_model: build a ClassyHubInterface from a PyTorch model using the from_model class method
